item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00022","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C09","C23","C07"],"selected_candidate_label":"C09","confidence":0.78,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C09 plausibly supplied the main rhetorical structure for the later retirement letter: an opening of profound personal regret, an extended appraisal of distinguished national service and professional qualities, consolation that the departing official will remain available to influence public affairs, and a closing assurance of national gratitude. The later letter adapts this resignation-letter framework to judicial retirement. C23 and C07 are related departure tributes, but their sequence and language are less closely aligned.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Your impending retirement fills me with regret... It is always difficult for me to express a sentiment of deep regret","parent_excerpt":"I have now to take a step which from the bottom of my heart I wish could be indefinitely deferred...
